prototypePolicy.portion: Bind an exact authored positive quantity to stable inventory lot provenance; never infer sample quantity.
prototypePolicy.start: Reserve the full sample portion, exclusive worker interval and evidence opportunity.
prototypePolicy.debit: Consume the full portion with the first positive credited work.
prototypePolicy.pauseAndSave: Retain credited labor and reservations; save and restore exactly; grant no offline progress.
prototypePolicy.cancel: Before positive work, release the unused portion. After positive work, retain the debit and close without check, refund, finding or transferable labor.
prototypePolicy.completedBlockedCheck: Retain AwaitingCheck and resolve once on eligible resume without more work or sample.
prototypePolicy.evidenceIdentity: Use physical sample identity and canonical inventory lineage; splitting, replacement from the same root, renaming and worker changes do not create new evidence.
prototypePolicy.repeatIdentity: Allow at most one resolved check per evidence basis and substantive authored method; identical renamed methods are the same method.
prototypePolicy.atomicity: Commit check, findings, RNG and receipt through the shared simulation transaction.
